verdict.rationale: Aider builds a concise repository map of the whole git repo, covering the most important classes, functions, types and call signatures, and `/map` prints it. `/ask` answers questions about the codebase without editing files, and Aider can work out which files need editing from a request. Community users corroborate this: one says it understood unfamiliar codebases much faster than grep/find, another says it answered questions like 'what code would process this URL'. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the repo map ranks and selects code for large codebases, and any evidence of visual or architectural overviews beyond the text map.
